output.text: {"notes":["The requested channels are read at absolute simulation time t=1.0 s in the world frame; position is in m, swing angle in rad, angular velocity in rad/s, and boundary_crossed is Boolean.","The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; positive swing angle displaces the load toward +x.","A scheduled support intervention runs on [0.532, 0.732) s: +0.5442853198414626 m/s² for 0.1 s, then the same magnitude with negative sign for 0.1 s, after which the support is stationary.","boundary_crossed means the load center of mass crosses x=0.1 m after the observation cutoff, using 0.005 m hysteresis."]}
